generated_asset.prompt: Use case: game-texture. Asset type: seamless repeatable physically based ALBEDO texture for a Korean palace perimeter stone wall in a realtime 3D game. Primary request: one square high resolution orthographic close-up texture of hand dressed rough gray granite masonry laid in horizontal courses of small rectangular and approximately square blocks, as seen in Seoul palace boundary walls. Rows straight and staggered, mixed block widths roughly 1.0 to 1.7 times their height, subtle imperfect chipped rectangular edges, pale gray-beige narrow recessed lime mortar. Real coarse crystalline granite surfaces with tiny pits, tool marks, granular quartz/mineral flecks, modest stone-to-stone warm-gray, cool-gray and taupe variation, occasional muted weathering. Clearly photographic material quality, not a stylized illustration, not polygonal honeycomb, not river pebbles, not bricks. Composition: full-bleed flat masonry only, about 7 to 9 courses visible across the square, uniform texel density, no border, seamless tiling along both edges. Lighting: neutral diffuse flat overcast material-scan lighting with minimal directional illumination, no cast shadows or baked bright highlights. No perspective, no ground, no sky, no vegetation, no roof, no people, no signage, no text, no watermark. Output must be usable as repeating albedo in a game shader. Create an original texture, not a replica of a particular photograph.
generated_asset.scope: Colour/albedo only; metre projection and small derivative bump are authored in shader. No claim of measured stone sizes, captured normal/roughness maps or perfect seamless scan.
